name: metis-llp
description: Rulescript v2 (.llp) language support — syntax highlighting + the metis toolchain as a language server (real compiler diagnostics, hover, completion, outline).

llp.server.command.description: Command to launch the LLP language server. Empty = auto-detect: metis/lang/lsp.py found up from the workspace, run with the theia venv python ($THEIA_ROOT, else the metis checkout's ../theia sibling, else python3).
